limits: Fixture uses direct API TLS and a short-lived service-account token with the generated namespace-only executor Role.
Admin kubectl is used for fixture namespace/RBAC setup and file-byte verification, not provider operations.
Fault points terminate the backend after successful PVC or Deployment POST before the adapter receives its UID.
Crash/recovery proves tested process-loss windows, not arbitrary host power loss or distributed atomicity.
No CSI snapshot, encryption, EKS or raw-disk functionality is claimed.
